title: Layer Masks in Photoshop - Day 6
summary: PHLEARN’s Day 6 tutorial demonstrates practical layer-mask techniques for creating a composite in Photoshop. The presenter guides viewers through isolating a subject with a mask, layering background elements (mountains and clouds), using AI Generative Fill to extend the background, and blending the pieces with mask-based adjustments. The video covers refining edges with Select and Mask (including Refine Edge and decontamination of color), adjusting mask density and feathering, unlinking and relinking layer and mask for independent movement, and applying lens blur via Camera Raw on a grouped background. It finishes with adjustment-layer masking (brightness/contrast and gradient maps) to achieve a cohesive, non-destructive final composite, and emphasizes saving as PSD to preserve masks.
